versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-enforced -- extraction/verify_all.py fails the run if tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's own allowlistVersion drifts from this field. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are documentation-only, hand-maintained markers with nothing automatically checking them.

sourceProject.name: Heidi Health clone (React/Vite rebuild)
sourceProject.note: A React 18.3.1 + Vite 5.4 + Tailwind 3.4 + react-router-dom 6.30 clone of the real, live commercial site heidihealth.com. The ORIGINAL live site runs Next.js (App Router) -- this clone deliberately rebuilds in Vite, it does not use Next.js. See CLONE_SPEC.md line 5 for the original framework observation and package.json for this project's real stack.

countsNote: Recomputed from disk by extraction/verify_all.py's check_manifest_counts() on every run -- not hand-bumped. A scratch-copy test that injects a wrong count here is included in this build's verification pass.
entryPointsNote: Every path above is inside this design-repo/ folder -- no '../' paths to the Heidi app's own src/ or CLONE_SPEC.md. Those are real, valuable evidence sources during the build, but they live outside this package; their citations are captured in extraction/measured-values.json instead, which degrades gracefully (a warning, not a failure) when no sibling source tree is present in a standalone copy.
complianceNote: Heidi Health is a real, live commercial healthcare company. See tokens/llm/asset-roles.json for the closed assetRole enum and its per-role AI-generation (may-generate-new / must-reuse-exact / must-not-fabricate) and licensing guidance -- real Heidi Health logos, real customer/clinician photos, real proprietary product screenshots, and real third-party compliance badges must never be reproduced or fabricated by a generator using this design-repo.
